content.trans: 好的，我明白了。请告诉我需要翻译的英文内容。

content.text: Right.
content.trans: 正确。以下是该短语在中文中的翻译：

content.text: Give that person or give an opportunity.
content.trans: 给这个或这个机会。

content.text: All right. So we don't know if she will give him a shot or not.
content.trans: 好的，我明白了。请告诉我需要翻译的英文句子。

content.text: But why don't we listen to the dialogue once more to hear these phrases in action?
content.trans: 英语：但为什么不重复一下对话，听听这些短语在实际中的应用呢？

content.text: Hey, you're early. Where's everyone?
content.trans: 你好，你早了。谁都在吗？

content.text: Well, I told them not to come.
content.trans: 好的，我明白了。请告诉我需要翻译的英文句子。

content.text: I made a reservation just for the two of us.
content.trans: 我只给你安排了我和你两个人。

content.text: I thought we could have a quiet evening all to ourselves.
content.trans: 我心想我们可以一个人安静地度过这个夜晚。

content.text: Oh, why?
content.trans: 英语：哦，为什么？

content.text: Jennifer, there's something I want to ask you.
content.trans: 英语：Jennifer，你有什么想问我的吗？

content.text: Sure. What is it?
content.trans: 确定。这是什么？

content.text: Okay, here's the thing.
content.trans: 好的，这里有一个例子：

content.text: I've always seen you as more than just a friend. And I can't take it anymore.
content.trans: 我始终认为你不仅仅只是一个朋友。我不能再继续这样了。

content.text: I know you better than anyone. I know the pros and cons of your personality.
content.trans: 我了解你比任何人都好。我了解你的优点和缺点。

content.text: I even know what side of the bed is yours.
content.trans: 我甚至知道你的床的那边是什么边。

content.text: I think we would be great together, don't you?
content.trans: 我同意，你也是。

content.text: Are you serious? We've been friends for years.
content.trans: 英语：你真的这么认真吗？我们已经很久没见面了。

content.text: We can't just change that overnight.
content.trans: 我们不能一晚上就改变这个。

content.text: I know. I never had the guts to tell you until today.
content.trans: 英语：我知道。我从今天开始再也不敢告诉你了。

content.text: So what do you say? Are you willing to give me a shot?
content.trans: 所以，你准备好了吗？

content.text: Ah, ah!
content.trans: 英语：Ah, ah!

content.text: All right, so an interesting dialogue and it opens up a cultural point.
content.trans: 好的，我明白了。请告诉我需要翻译的英文句子。

content.text: That's right. So in the dialogue, the guy was asking her if she would be his girlfriend, right?
content.trans: 是的，你说得对。在对话中，那个男人正在问她是否愿意成为她的男朋友，对吗？

content.text: Right. But I guess it's not very common among adults at least in English-speaking countries.
content.trans: 英语：它很傻瓜。

content.text: Yeah, we don't say like, okay, so please will you be my boyfriend now?
content.trans: 是的，我们不那么说，好吗？你愿意和我做朋友吗？

content.text: Right, right. You would do that maybe in high school.
content.trans: 好的，我明白了。请告诉我需要翻译的英文句子。

content.text: Yeah, but even then I think it's still a little funny.
content.trans: 是的，但即使这样，我还是觉得它还是有点儿奇怪。

content.text: I think for us, when we start to have romantic relationships, it just sort of happens naturally, right?
content.trans: 英语：我认为，当我们开始有浪漫关系时，它就像自然而然发生的一样。

content.text: You never really have this conversation. Will you be my boyfriend?
content.trans: 你从不真正地和我谈这个话题。你会是我女朋友吗？

content.text: Yes, afterwards you just start talking about other things, which you just consider that you guys are already boyfriend and girlfriend.
content.trans: 是的，之后你只是开始谈论其他话题，而你已经考虑自己和你们之间的关系了。

content.text: Yeah. But there's no real...
content.trans: 是的。不过没有真正的...

content.text: There's no official starting point.
content.trans: 没有官方的开始点。

content.text: There's no official point that says, okay, now we are boyfriend and girlfriend.
content.trans: 没有官方的点，现在我们是男朋友和女朋友。

content.text: Yep. Which is interesting because in other countries they do go through the formality of asking somebody to become their boyfriend.
content.trans: 是的。这很有趣，因为在其他国家，他们去问某人成为他们的男朋友是礼貌的一部分。

content.text: Yeah, but even, you know, like 20 or 30 years ago in English-speaking countries, you would do this.
content.trans: 是的，但即使如此，在英语国家，你也会在20或30年前这样干。

content.text: Oh, yeah, of course.
content.trans: 英语：哦，对了。

content.text: Going steady.
content.trans: 走稳。

content.text: Going steady.
content.trans: 一直稳。

content.text: So you would ask, well, you go steady with me.
content.trans: 所以，你愿意这样回答吗？

content.text: That means let's become a stable couple.
content.trans: 这句话的中文翻译是：这意味着让我们成为一对稳定的人。

content.text: Exactly.
content.trans: 正好。

content.text: Alright, so we want to hear your stories and well, how do you do it in your country?
content.trans: 好的，现在请将“Alright, so we want to hear your stories and well, how do you do it in your country?” 用简化中文翻译。

content.text: Do you ask someone out? Do you maybe just give them the first kiss and that's an automatic yes?
content.trans: 英语：你问我分手？或者，也许只是给你第一吻，那自然就是肯定的了。

content.text: Well, I don't know, but I'm looking forward to hearing from our listeners.
content.trans: 英语：嗯，我不太知道，但我期待着你们的反馈。

content.text: So guys, check out our website, EnglishPod.com.
content.trans: 英语：所以，朋友们，请看看我们的网站，www.englishpod.com。

content.text: You can leave your questions and comments there.
content.trans: 你可以在那里留下你的问题和评论。

content.text: Alright, we'll see you guys there and until next time.
content.trans: 好的，我明白了。请告诉我需要翻译的英文内容。

content.text: Goodbye.
content.trans: 再见。

content.text: Bye.
content.trans: 再见。
